name: Auxiliary AC source-transfer interface
summary: Transfers the assigned room AC bus between documented available sources.
description: Transfers the assigned room AC bus between documented available sources. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Auxiliary-source health” at the input and “Selected AC bus source” at the output. Source interlocking must prevent unintended paralleling.

Label source, branch protection and load purpose. The arrangement does not establish conductor sizes, protection settings or installation compliance; it links the operating role to the selected equipment schedule. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
